newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola raised to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Michael Branca upgraded Coca-Cola Co to buy from neutral "on our forecast for the international case volume growth rate to accelerate to the 10 percent level in 1997 -- at the top end of the company's well-known eight to 10 percent volume growth rate objective."
-- In a report, the analyst said he raised his 1997 share earnings estimate to $1.66 from $1.63 and 1998's to $1.96 from $1.92.
-- "Bottler infrastructure investments (will) drive core market volume growth and enable Coke to realize emerging market volume growth potential," the analyst said.
